_original_lore: The Revenant Champion is a Revenant Horror/Zombie
Slayer Miniboss that has a small chance to be
spawned when a player with an active Revenant Horror
Tier IV Quest Kills a Zombie.
name: 亡魂勇士 (小首领)

source: The Revenant Champion is a Revenant Horror/Zombie
Slayer Miniboss that has a small chance to be
spawned when a player with an active Revenant Horror
Tier IV Quest Kills a Zombie.
loreParagraphs.translation: 亡魂勇士是亡魂恐魔/僵尸杀手小首领,当拥有进行中的亡魂恐魔 IV 阶任务的玩家击杀僵尸时,有小概率生成.

styleMappings.Revenant Horror/Zombie Slayer Miniboss: 亡魂恐魔/僵尸杀手小首领
